root_cause.message: Redis KEYS command caused redis cpu usage spike during cache scan

expected.business_impact: /admin/cache/scan production business path is affected by redis_keys_command

primary_evidence.trace: Runtime trace follows admin-gateway -> admin-service -> redis-session and localizes the main fault at admin-service.
primary_evidence.log: Root service logs contain RedisSlowCommandException and redis_keys_command keywords.
primary_evidence.metric: Metric redis.cpu.usage.percent breaches threshold on admin-service.

non_root_noise: admin-gateway has slow client span but no redis CPU metric
background audit-service warning is outside the affected call path
noise-service metric is normal and outside the affected call path
